# Rows: <class> TAB <file> TAB <trigger> TAB <the hit's line, whitespace-joined>; no line numbers, so a moved line
# still matches. tests/test_0048_evidence.py compares these rows, as a multiset, with the tripwire's --sites output:
# a new hit, or an edit to a hit's line, fails until it is classified here. Written at 1e80d4c by dev, after reading
# every site; research samples the classifications. The verb trigger (`str:sql-write`) and the
# last three classes were added with it, research's stage 2b.
# Classes (closed; the test refuses any other):
#   census-writer               a token of one of the five confidence writers census_0048 counts (§2c-ii row 8):
#                               the model_copy call, or its `confidence` key and value
#   edge-json-writer            one of the seven edge json writers census_0048 counts (§2c-ii row 8)
#   copy-other-fields           model_copy whose update names no `confidence` (or a deep copy with no update);
#                               scope_read.py's whole-provenance replacement is resolved by the census to
#   read                        reads a confidence value into a comparison, message, journal record or projection;
#   field-name                  `confidence` as a field name in a tuple, a check or a message
#   fold-checked                store/revocation_sweep.py's recompute: min/max over inputs whose domain [0, 1] is
#                               checked (refusing otherwise) at its payload check; the result reaches the store only
#                               through the census writer at store/sqlite.py (the `float(values['confidence'])` key)
#   declaration                 Provenance's own field declaration, with its bounds
#   other-object                the trigger names something that is not a Provenance: getattr on a config, client or
#                               record attribute; `copy` as a local path; object.__setattr__ inside the __init__ of a
#                               non-pydantic immutable class (PolicyLane, EvidenceContext, SuccessorLookup), and those
#   edges-sql-not-a-json-write  SQL that reads, defines or deletes edges, writing no json; the `"edges" if … else
#                               "episodes"` table selectors feed SELECTs only, and the one in _redact_in_txn is
#   edges-text                  `edges` as a word in a message, a dict key, a label or a site name
#   episode-json-writer         a SQL write of an episode row's json: outside C on the owner's ruling (0048 §10
#                               Q6, edges only), the named follow-up of §8 (the ten in store/sqlite.py, and
#   sql-write-other-table       a SQL write to a table other than edges and episodes (journals, ledgers,
#                               receipts, redactions, embeddings, the wiki, counters, identity)
#   verb-as-text                `update`, `insert` or `replace` as a word that is not SQL: prose, a word list, an
#                               operation name, a codec's error handler
